CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Crafts: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Crafts with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Crafts.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Crafts.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Crafts.

2. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Green, orange, and purple

   D. Refuse all feedback on Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.

6. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)

8. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

10. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

11. Best practice when working on Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)

12. Best practice when working on Rugby: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rugby with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rugby.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rugby.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rugby.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and Mosaic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Rugby and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Photography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
